name: Temporal Distortion
summary: Words fall slower for a while.
description: Every scroll falls at 60% speed for 8 seconds. New scrolls keep arriving at the same pace: Slow buys you time to keep up, it doesn't stop the chaos. Casting again while it lasts adds another slow, so two together are slower still. Arcane Rush time passes 20% slower while you are slowed.

name: Arcane Shield
summary: 2 layers block Ward breaches for 7 s.
description: Raises 2 shield layers for 7 seconds. Each layer stops one scroll that reaches the Ward: it does no harm and costs no Combo. Barrier protects the Ward only; a typo still costs your Combo and Arcane Rush. Casting again refreshes the shield to 2 layers and 7 seconds; it never stacks higher. Prototype values.

name: Gale
summary: Pushes every scroll back, hardest near the Ward.
description: A gust pushes every scroll on the field back up, strongest on the ones closest to the Ward. Nothing is destroyed: every scroll keeps its word, its speed and its value, so you get a second chance to type it and score it. Wind never heals the Ward and never captures words. Prototype values.

name: Incineration
summary: Burns the low field; pays nothing.
description: Every scroll in the lower half of the field ignites, and flames leap to any scroll close enough to a burning one. Scrolls in the top fifth are always spared. Burned scrolls are simply gone: no points, no Combo, no Arcane Rush, no checkpoint progress, and any spell they carried is lost. Fire trades score for survival. Prototype reach.

name: Frostbinding
summary: Freezes scrolls and spawns; Focus builds Combo.
description: Freezes every word in place, and stops new words appearing, for 8 seconds. You can keep typing, and Arcane Rush time keeps running. Frostbound Focus: each perfectly typed word during one freeze adds +2, +4, +8, then +8 Combo instead of +1. A typo breaks the Focus run (and, as always, the Combo). Focus resets when the freeze ends. Casting again while frozen adds time, less each cast (8 s, 5.6, 3.9 …), and keeps the Focus run going. If you clear the whole board while it is frozen, the ice melts over 2 seconds: a short rest, then words return.

name: Chain Lightning
summary: Strikes the lowest scroll and its cluster.
description: Lightning strikes the scroll closest to the Ward and always conducts through the scrolls clustered around it. Then it may jump to the nearest other cluster, and from there to another: each jump is half as likely as the last, but there is no fixed limit (seeded, so a replay strikes the same way). Struck scrolls count toward your next checkpoint and pay their base points × your Combo. Shock never adds Combo or Arcane Rush. The odds are provisional.

name: Transmutation
summary: Shortens long scrolls; they keep their worth.
description: Every scroll of 5 or more letters on the field is rewritten as a 2–3 letter word, in place, at the same speed. It still pays the original word's full base points when you type it. Shorter scrolls already on the field, and every scroll that arrives later, are unchanged. It earns Combo and Arcane Rush only the normal way, by typing.

name: Harvest
summary: Claims every word, cashing in Combo and Rush.
description: Claims every scroll on the field: they all count toward your next checkpoint and pay their full base points × your Combo multiplier × your active Arcane Rush multiplier (without a Rush, base × Combo). Your Combo stays; your Arcane Rush is spent. Harvest never adds Combo or Arcane Rush.
